Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repo root: it has the definition of done, conventions and commit
rules for this project. Before changing code, read the docs it points to:

- `docs/structure.md`: where code lives and which Android file matches which iOS file.
- `docs/design.md`: UI tokens, components to reuse and screen patterns. Read it before any
  screen work; build new screens from the existing components.
- `docs/decisions.md`: product decisions already made. Don't reverse one without asking.
- `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/protocol.md`: before touching sessions, transports or messages.

Put new docs in `docs/`, not the repo root.
